_about: Thaimart · ส่งงานขึ้น Storybook · ไฟล์ตั้งค่าของโปรเจกต์ (made by the install command only when missing: it never overwrites a filled file). The skill thaimart-storybook reads it. Fill it when the team sends the details; leave a field empty and keep pending true until then.
_status: repo ready (3 Nov 2569): GitLab uxi-team/thaimart-redesign; the React and Flutter packages are not ready yet

repo._help: url: the central Storybook repo (GitLab or GitHub). platform: gitlab or github.

react._help: importFrom: the team's React component package, e.g. @thaimart/ui (empty until it exists).

flutter._help: tool: how the central Storybook shows Flutter (in thaimart-redesign: a Dart file next to the React one, shown as a code tab). package: the team's Flutter design system package.

html._help: HTML prototypes are converted to this target; an HTML story is kept only when allowHtmlStories is true.

review._help: leads: the GitLab or GitHub usernames of the Lead reviewers.

registry._help: A newer component registry (JSON) from the design system team. Empty = the registry inside the skill.

mr._help: auto = glab or gh when installed and logged in; glab; gh; none = print the steps.
